name: 4-HO-NET
summary: 4-HO-NET, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-ethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT). It was not included by Alexander Shulgin in his 1997 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved) and its properties and effects in humans are unknown.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-NET, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-ethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT). The drug acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is known from laboratory research on serotonin receptors. No medical use exists.
uses.zh: 它出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is related to norpsilocin, a compound with only one chain on its nitrogen that was identified in magic mushrooms in 2017. 4-HO-NET has an ethyl group in that one spot.
fact.zh: 它與去甲脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（norpsilocin）有關；這種氮原子上只有一條鏈的化合物於2017年在迷幻蘑菇中被發現。4-HO-NET在那個位置上接的是乙基。
fact.zhHans: 它与去甲脱磷酸裸盖菇素（norpsilocin）有关；这种氮原子上只有一条链的化合物于2017年在迷幻蘑菇中被发现。4-HO-NET在那个位置上接的是乙基。
